name: Community — MiniMax H3 Perfect Looper
author: CoolBreeze_ (workflow), seitanism (bridge node), Larryvrh (Turbo LoRA)
description:
Model format: int8 ConvRot. Steps: 6 by default.

Seamless looping video with sound from MiniMax H3, after CoolBreeze_'s Perfect Looper workflow (Civitai 3023857). Each card renders a short anchor clip, then a bridge clip that starts on the anchor's last frames and ends on its first ones, held in place by seitanism's H3 Masked AV Bridge node, so the end of the result runs straight back into its start. Larryvrh's Turbo LoRA at 6 steps. Two sets of cards: the official pruned H3 base, and Singularity v2 (darker, the same file as the Singularity v2 pack).

Best for motion that can repeat: something performed on the spot, a there-and-back move, a full camera orbit, a stream of things crossing the frame. Leave music out: a beat will not line up across the join, so add a track afterwards.

The join itself was clean in every test. In about 2 loops in 5, though, the picture drifts during the loop (often a slow push-in, or the subject coming closer) and snaps back into place in the last few frames. Start the shot with the looping line each card gives and say the camera does not move; if the end still snaps, run it again with another seed.

presets.name: MiniMax H3 Perfect Looper - Text to Video
presets.tagline: Describe a scene - a seamless loop with sound
presets.description:
Describe a scene and get a seamless loop with sound, on the official pruned H3 base with the Turbo LoRA at 6 steps. About 3 minutes for 7 seconds at 480p on a 12 GB card.

Write one shot, [Shot 1], and start its text with "No video cuts. Looping video. Movement loops in the end." Describe a motion that can repeat, and say the camera stays still or ends where it started. Leave music out.

The loop comes out a little shorter than the duration you pick (7 s gives 6.4 s). If the last moment snaps back into place (about 2 test loops in 5 did), run it again with another seed.

Model format: int8 ConvRot.

extensions.name: rgthree-comfy
extensions.description: Power Lora Loader (user LoRA slot)

extensions.name: ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-Turbo
extensions.description: Turbo LoRA loader node + dual-schedule sampler node (required - the workflow will fail to load without it)

extensions.name: ComfyUI-KJNodes
extensions.description: Provides PathchSageAttentionKJ for the faster-attention opt-in

extensions.name: ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context-MultiRef
extensions.description: MiniMaxH3MaskedAVBridge: locks the anchor's ends into the bridge latent (GPL-3.0, pure Python). Same pin as the Chain packs.

requirements.notes: Two H3 passes per loop (a 56-frame anchor, then the bridge). Weights are the same files as the official H3 pack plus the 744 MB Larryvrh Turbo LoRA. Needs ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context-MultiRef (seitanism, GPL-3.0) for the bridge node, pinned to the same commit as the Chain packs. Measured on a 12 GB RTX 4070 Ti with 32 GB RAM, 480p, 7 s, faster attention on: about 2 min 45 s per loop over 18 runs, about 3 minutes on engine 0.45 including model load. The last few frames snapped back into place on 7 of those 18 runs (prompts without the looping line) and on 3 of 7 later runs with the looping line, on new subjects too.

presets.name: MiniMax H3 Perfect Looper - Image to Video
presets.tagline: Your picture starts a seamless loop with sound
presets.description:
Your picture becomes the start of a seamless loop with sound, on the official pruned H3 base with the Turbo LoRA at 6 steps. The picture is centre-cropped to the shape you choose, and the loop opens a few frames after it (the picture's own frame is trimmed off). Describe what happens from that picture on. About 3 minutes for 7 seconds at 480p on a 12 GB card.

Write one shot, [Shot 1], and start its text with "No video cuts. Looping video. Movement loops in the end." Describe a motion that can repeat, and say the camera stays still or ends where it started. Leave music out.

The loop comes out a little shorter than the duration you pick (7 s gives 6.4 s). If the last moment snaps back into place (about 2 test loops in 5 did), run it again with another seed.

Model format: int8 ConvRot.
